release_notes:
🚀 CineMax v1.3.5: Major Update

🎨 Full App Redesign:
- Completely reworked UI across all screens for a cleaner and more premium feel.
- Smoother animations and improved layout consistency throughout the app.

⚽ Sports Section:
- New dedicated section for live matches, fixture tables, and match schedules.
- Stream live matches directly inside the app.

📺 Source Fixes & New Sources:
- All existing sources have been fully fixed and stabilized.
- Quality options added where available (1080p / 720p / 480p).
- New Indian sources added based on popular user request.

🎮 Player Improvements:
- New floating player mode — browse content while watching.
- Portrait mode support added for a more comfortable viewing experience.
- Audio track switcher added to change language directly from the player menu.

⚡ Performance Improvements:
- Faster app startup and smoother navigation.
- Better memory management and reduced lag.

🚀 Enjoy the biggest CineMax update yet!
